L1883@P60: Subsection B21 - Exit Requirements for Use Classification 5a
L1884@P60: Clause B21.1
L1885@P60: Buildings of Use Classification 5a should be provided with exits as follows:
L1886@P60: (a) if the Use Classification 5a is located at a storey less than 12m above ground floor
L1887@P60: level, Table B2 should be complied with;
L1888@P60: (b) if any part of Use Classification 5a is located at a storey 12m or more above ground
L1889@P60: floor level, Table B5 should be complied with.

L1907@P60: Notes:
L1908@P60: 1. Buildings with total occupant capacity of Use Classification 5a over 3000 persons, the

L1913@P61: Clause B21.2
L1914@P61: Adequate exit routes complying with Clause B21.1 should be provided for every tier or floor.
L1915@P61: Clause B21.3
L1916@P61: Two of the exit routes from each tier or floor should open into different thoroughfares or
L1917@P61: ways.
L1918@P61: Clause B21.4
L1919@P61: Each tier or floor in a Use Classification 5a shall be constructed so that it does not have a
L1920@P61: gradient steeper than 35° to the horizontal and the headroom between any such floor or tier
L1921@P61: and the underside of the tier or ceiling above it shall in every part be at least 3m.
L1922@P61: Clause B21.5
L1923@P61: In calculating the number of persons who can be accommodated in any tier or floor or part
L1924@P61: of a tier or floor, the accommodation of all standing and waiting spaces in such tier or floor
L1925@P61: or part of a tier or floor should be included. Any cafe, lounge, restaurant or foyer should be
L1926@P61: regarded as a waiting space.
L1927@P61: Clause B21.6
L1928@P61: Exit routes should be arranged so as to afford a ready means of escape from all parts of
L1929@P61: each tier or floor and should lead directly into thoroughfares.
L1930@P61: Clause B21.7
L1931@P61: The exit routes from each part of each tier or floor should be placed in a position remote
L1932@P61: from the stage.
L1933@P61: Clause B21.8
L1934@P61: All entrances and exit doors, other than pass doors in connection with spaces in which
L1935@P61: persons await admission, should be arranged so as to be available for exit during the whole
L1936@P61-62: of the time that the public are within the premises.54
L1937@P62: Subsection B22 – Exits, Notices, etc.
L1938@P62: Clause B22.1
L1939@P62: All exit doors or openings from a premises of Use Classification 5a and from the stage and
L1940@P62: dressing rooms in such place should be clearly indicated by sufficient directional and exit
L1941@P62: signs. Such signs should comply with the requirements in the Code of Practice for Minimum
L1942@P62: Fire Service Installations and Equipment.
L1943@P62: Clause B22.2
L1944@P62: [Clause deleted.]
L1945@P62: Clause B22.3
L1946@P62: Doors and openings other than exits within sight of the audiences, which lead to portions of
L1947@P62: Use Classification 5a accessible to the public, should have notices placed over them
L1948@P62: indicating the use of such portions so that such doors and openings will not be mistaken as
L1949@P62: exits.
L1950@P62: Clause B22.4
L1951@P62: Notices, signs and handpointers indicating the exit direction should be provided.
L1952@P62: Clause B22.5
L1953@P62: Notices bearing the words NO EXIT should not be provided.
L1954@P62: Clause B22.6
L1955@P62: Each notice indicating an exit should be illuminated by a light on two systems as the lighting
L1956@P62: referred to in Clause B25.6.
L1957@P62: Clause B22.7
L1958@P62: The lighting of exit notices should not in any circumstances be extinguished or dimmed
L1959@P62-63: while the public are in the places of public entertainment.55
L1960@P63: Subsection B23 - Required Staircases
L1961@P63: Clauses B23.1
L1962@P63: All required staircases in this Section should comply with the following requirements:
L1963@P63: (a) The required staircase have no winders;
L1964@P63: (b) Each flight is of not more than 16 or of less than 3 steps;
L1965@P63: (c) The required staircase should not have more than 2 successive flights without a
L1966@P63: turn;
L1967@P63: (d) There should be a turn between 2 successive flights if any one of them has more
L1968@P63: than 12 steps in a flight; and
L1969@P63: (e) Treads should be not less than 280mm wide and risers should be not more than
L1970@P63: 150mm high.
L1971@P63: Clauses B23.2
L1972@P63: Where a flight of steps in a Use Classification 5a returns, the newel wall should be chased
L1973@P63: so as to allow the handrail to turn without projecting over the landing.
L1974@P63: Clause B23.3
L1975@P63: Any recess in the walls of a required staircase should be defended by guardrails.
L1976@P63: Subsection B24 – Barriers
L1977@P63: Clause B24.1
L1978@P63: Any barriers which may be provided for checking or controlling admission should be
L1979@P63: arranged so that the portions immediately in the line of exit open automatically upon
L1980@P63: pressure being applied in the direction of exit and so as not to reduce the width of the exit
L1981@P63: route. All fixed directional barriers to define the exit route should have adequate strength
L1982@P63: complying with the requirements in section 9 of the Building (Construction) Regulation.
L1983@P63: Clause B24.2
L1984@P63: Rope barriers should be fitted with automatic catches or slip connexions and should be
L1985@P63: arranged so as not to trail on the floor when parted and the fittings should not project into
L1986@P63-64: the gangway or exit route.56
L1987@P64: Subsection B25 – Exit Route Details
L1988@P64: Clause B25.1
L1989@P64: Chains or padlocks should not be used to secure exit doors. When any other locking
L1990@P64: mechanism is used, the doors should be readily opened from inside without using a key.
L1991@P64: Clause B25.2
L1992@P64: The gangways and seatways layout should comply with the requirements in Clause B27.6.
L1993@P64: Clause B25.3
L1994@P64: All gangways, exit routes and the treads of steps and required staircases should have slipresistant surfaces.
L1995@P64: Clause B25.4
L1996@P64: The edges of the tread of steps and staircases should be conspicuous.
L1997@P64: Clause B25.5
L1998@P64: Where tiered seating is provided and is located such that persons could fall more than
L1999@P64: 1000mm, a guard rail should be provided at a height of at least 1100mm to prevent falling.
L2000@P64: Clause B25.6
L2001@P64: All portions of a premises of Use Classification 5a to which the public have access should
L2002@P64: be provided with lighting of a horizontal illuminance at floor level of not less than 30 lux. The
L2003@P64: lighting can be a combination of natural and artificial lighting and should be backed up by an
L2004@P64: emergency lighting system that complies with the Code of Practice for Minimum Fire Service
L2005@P64-65: Installations and Equipment.57
L2006@P65: Subsection B26 - Exit from Stages
L2007@P65: Clause B26.1
L2008@P65: Where a permanent stage is provided, an exit should be provided from each side of the
L2009@P65: stage, and one of such exits should lead directly to a thoroughfare and should comply with
L2010@P65: Table B2 or Table B5 as appropriate.
L2011@P65: Clause B26.2
L2012@P65: An exit route leading directly to a thoroughfare should be provided from the stage basement,
L2013@P65: and should comply with Table B2 or Table B5 as appropriate.
L2014@P65: Subsection B27 – Cinemas in Multi-storey Buildings
L2015@P65: Clause B27.1
L2016@P65: Cinemas accommodating not more than 2,000 people in aggregate in any one building may
L2017@P65: be situated in any one storey or storeys within a non-domestic building or the non-domestic
L2018@P65: part of a composite building.
L2019@P65: Clause B27.2
L2020@P65: A cinema or cinemas with an occupant capacity not more than 2,000 people in aggregate
L2021@P65: situated in a non-domestic building or the non-domestic part of a composite building may
L2022@P65: share the protected exits with other non-domestic use of the same building, subject to
L2023@P65: compliance with the following requirements:
L2024@P65: (a) All cinema auditoria should be provided with a dedicated smoke extraction
L2025@P65: system and other fire service installations to the satisfaction of Director of Fire
L2026@P65: Services;
L2027@P65: (b) All cinema auditoria should be separated from other accommodations with walls
L2028@P65: and floors having adequate FRR as required in Part C.
L2029@P65: (c) Every door to a cinema auditorium should have an FRR of not less than that
L2030@P65: required for the walls of the cinema auditorium. Door openings at the cinema
L2031@P65: auditoria giving access to the cinema foyer or the adjoining non-domestic
L2032@P65: accommodations are not required to be provided with a protected lobby;
L2033@P65: (d) Separation should be provided between the cinema auditoria and the cinema
L2034@P65: foyers in accordance with the requirements in (b) and (c) above. Such
L2035@P65: separation is not required if the smoke extraction system is also provided to the
L2036@P65: cinemas foyer to the satisfaction of the Director of Fire Services and, in such
L2037@P65: case, adequate fire separation should be provided between the foyer and other
L2038@P65: accommodations of the building. Any openings made in the separating walls
L2039@P65: between the foyer and adjoining accommodations for communication should be
L2040@P65: protected by a fire rated door or a fire shutter having an FRR not less than that
L2041@P65-66: of the wall;58
L2042@P66: (e) The protected exits which serve both the cinema and the adjoining
L2043@P66: accommodations should be accessible from the common circulation area of the
L2044@P66: building without having to pass through other private premises;
L2045@P66: (f) If a required staircase is directly connected to a cinema at any one storey and
L2046@P66: the occupants of the cinema do not need to pass through the adjoining nondomestic accommodation to reach the staircase, the part of staircase from that
L2047@P66: storey to the final point of discharge should comply with Subsection B23. At the
L2048@P66: transition point where there is a change in the dimension of treads and risers, a
L2049@P66: flat landing of length not less than twice the width of the required staircase
L2050@P66: should be provided. A notice in English and Chinese with words and characters
L2051@P66: “Beware of steps change” and “小心梯級高度改變” of not less than 50mm high
L2052@P66: should be provided to alert occupants of the change in the step configuration;
L2053@P66: (g) The shared protected exits should be designed to have adequate widths and
L2054@P66: sizes based on the total occupant capacity of the cinema and the adjoining nondomestic accommodation complying with the requirements in Subsection B21;
L2055@P66: (h) In a composite building, the exit routes of the cinema should be separated from
L2056@P66: the exit routes of the domestic parts of the building;
L2057@P66: (i) The exit routes of the cinemas including those shared exits should discharge to
L2058@P66: streets of not less than 4.5m wide. Two of the exit routes from each floor
L2059@P66: should discharge into different streets; and
L2060@P66: (j) The cinema is not situated at basement.
L2061@P66: The entrance to the cinemas or to the cinema foyer may be provided through the circulation
L2062@P66: area of the adjoining non-domestic accommodations, such as a shopping arcade, subject to
L2063@P66: compliance with the above requirements.
L2064@P66: Clause B27.3
L2065@P66: A cinema should not be situated at basement except for the first basement floor. A cinema
L2066@P66: at the first basement floor should comply with the following requirements:
L2067@P66: (a) All exit routes from the cinema auditorium to the required staircases and from the
L2068@P66: required staircases to the street should be short and direct ;
L2069@P66: (b) All required staircases/exits from the cinema should discharge independently onto a
L2070@P66: street;
L2071@P66: (c) All required staircases serving other basement floors should be sealed off at the
L2072@P66: floor where the cinema is situated;
L2073@P66: (d) At least one of the protected exits should be a firefighting and rescue stairway
L2074@P66: designed and constructed in accordance with Part D;
L2075@P66: (e) The widths of the required staircases should comply with Table B5;
